run_evolution: run evolution on a program file using an evaluator script to find the best optimized code
evolve_function: evolve a Python function by running it against a list of test cases with expected outputs
evolve_algorithm: evolve an algorithm class by benchmarking its instance methods and optimizing for performance metrics
evolve_code: evolve arbitrary Python code by providing initial code and a custom evaluator function
EvolutionResult: access the best program code, score, and metrics from a completed evolution run
